skill.name: media-use
skill.description: Resolve background music, sound effects, images, and icons into local files with manifests, cache reuse, and HeyGen provider search.
skill.summary: Resolve media needs into local assets, manifests, and reusable cache entries.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are false positives from Markdown backticks, JavaScript template literals, tests, comments, and CSS. Confirmed risks include the curl-to-shell installer documentation, hidden home-directory cache usage, external HeyGen and ffprobe execution, and unvalidated provider downloads. No prompt injection text was found.

remediation.issue: Network installer is piped directly to bash.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl-to-shell instruction with checksum-pinned download steps and a fixed CLI version.

remediation.issue: Provider download URLs are trusted without validation.
remediation.suggestion: Require https and an allowlist of expected HeyGen asset hosts before freezeUrl downloads or writes any bytes.

remediation.issue: Manifest and cache paths can escape intended directories.
remediation.suggestion: Reject absolute paths and normalized parent traversal before contentHash, importFromCache, and promote use stored paths.

remediation.issue: The evaluation report interpolates unescaped manifest data.
remediation.suggestion: Escape all manifest fields, asset references, filenames, and descriptions before writing eval-report.html.

remediation.issue: The global cache stores assets in a hidden home-directory path.
remediation.suggestion: Make global cache reuse opt-in or document clear inspection and cleanup steps for ~/.media.

content.user_title: Resolve Media Assets for AI Video Projects
content.value_statement: Media-heavy projects need audio, images, and icons without cluttering the assistant context. This skill resolves assets into local files, manifests, and reusable cache entries.
actual_capabilities: Resolves background music, sound effects, images, and icons through one CLI workflow.
Searches HeyGen audio and asset catalogs through the HeyGen command line tool.
Adopts existing files from an assets directory into a project media manifest.
Downloads or copies selected media into structured local .media folders.
Generates manifest JSONL records and a readable .media/index.md inventory.
Reuses matching assets from a global ~/.media cache when available.
limitations: Provider search requires the HeyGen CLI and valid HeyGen credentials.
The skill performs network downloads and writes files to local project directories.
It does not verify media licensing, brand suitability, or content safety by itself.
Corrupted local manifests or cache records can affect reuse until cleaned.

use_cases.title: Resolve video background music
use_cases.description: Find a fitting background track and register it in the project media inventory.

use_cases.title: Organize existing campaign assets
use_cases.description: Adopt current images, icons, and audio files into a structured manifest before editing.

use_cases.title: Reuse media across generated projects
use_cases.description: Pull repeated logos, sounds, and brand assets from the global cache when prompts match.

prompt_templates.prompt: Find upbeat background music for a short product launch video in this project.

prompt_templates.title: Find a matching image
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve a clean technology background image for a dashboard introduction scene.

prompt_templates.prompt: Adopt the existing project assets, then summarize which audio and image files were registered.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve with reuse context
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve a reusable transparent icon for Acme, prefer a cached match, and report the registered media path.

output_examples.input: Need an upbeat product launch background track.
output_examples.output: The skill resolves a background music file, stores it under the project media folder, and records duration metadata.

output_examples.input: Need a rocket icon for a launch animation.
output_examples.output: The skill selects an icon asset, saves it locally, and records transparency and provider provenance.
The skill registers existing audio and image files, then refreshes the readable media inventory.

best_practices: Review provider results and licensing before publishing generated media.
Inspect .media/index.md after each resolve or adopt operation.
Keep HeyGen credentials in approved auth storage, not in prompts or manifests.
anti_patterns: Do not run network installer scripts without reviewing and pinning them.
Do not treat the global cache as trusted across unrelated projects.
Do not publish unreviewed media assets in customer-facing deliverables.

faq.question: What media types does this skill resolve?
faq.answer: It resolves background music, sound effects, images, and icons.

faq.question: Does it need external credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. HeyGen provider search requires the HeyGen CLI and valid authentication.

faq.question: Where are resolved files stored?
faq.answer: Project assets are stored under .media, with inventory records in .media/manifest.jsonl and .media/index.md.

faq.question: Can it reuse assets between projects?
faq.answer: Yes. Matching reusable assets can be read from the global ~/.media cache.

faq.question: Does it generate new media by itself?
faq.answer: It mainly searches, downloads, copies, adopts, and registers media from providers or local files.

faq.question: Is this safe for automatic installation?
faq.answer: Automatic installation should require review because the documentation includes a curl-to-shell installer pattern.
